question: What is the validity period and fee schedule for a Ground Preparation and Excavation Permit (GP&EP)?
answer:
The Ground Preparation and Excavation Permit (GP&EP) is valid for thirty (30) days or is superseded upon the issuance of the Building Permit [S4]. The fee schedule for a GP&EP is as follows:

- Inspection and Verification Fee: Php 200.00 [S4]
- Per cubic meter of excavation: Php 3.00 [S4]
- Issuance of GP&EP fee: Php 50.00 [S4]
- For foundation with basement, per cubic meter of excavation: Php 4.00 [S4]
- Excavation other than foundation or basement, per cubic meter: not specified in the provided sources

For commercial/industrial buildings (Groups B, E, F, G) up to 10.00 meters in height, the fee for a GP&EP is Php 2,400.00, and every meter or fraction thereof in excess of 10.00 meters is Php 120.00 [S1]. Accessory fees are not included in the abovementioned fees [S2].

ground_truth: While a main Building Permit is undergoing evaluation, the Building Official may issue a Ground Preparation and Excavation Permit (GP&EP) for foundation work, valid for thirty (30) days or until superseded by the building permit. Statutory fees are: 1) Inspection and Verification Fee of PHP 200.00; 2) Issuance fee of PHP 50.00; 3) Excavation fee of PHP 3.00 per cubic meter (or PHP 4.00 per cubic meter for foundations with basements); and 4) PHP 250.00 per square meter for authorized foundation encroachments into public areas.
